# Operational loss event (`loss-event` v1)

An operational loss: Basel event type, business line, gross loss, recoveries and its timeline.

**Group:** Operational and non-financial risk · **Mnemonic:** `LOSS` · **Identifiers:** `LOSS-…` in `eventId`

Open one with `LOSS <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: loss-event
version: 1
description: "An operational loss: Basel event type, business line, gross loss, recoveries and its timeline."
match: { kind: loss-event, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Operational and non-financial risk · Operational loss event, id: $.eventId }
strip:
  - { label: Event type, bind: $.eventType }
  - { label: Desk, bind: $.deskName }
  - { label: Gross loss, bind: $.grossLoss, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Recoveries, bind: $.recoveries, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Net loss, bind: $.netLoss, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
  - { label: Occurred, bind: $.occurred, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: details
    kind: kv
    title: Event
    key: F2
    rows: $.details
  - id: timeline
    kind: ladder
    title: Timeline
    key: F3
    rows: $.timeline
    columns:
      - { label: Date, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Step, bind: "@.step" }
      - { label: By, bind: "@.by" }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.desk, 'desk')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
